model: repeated-measures ANOVA: every subject measured at every level of the within-subject factors
effect_size: generalized eta squared (ges), partial eta squared (pes)
posthoc: emmeans pairwise or vs-control contrasts; multivariate model for within-subject contrasts (no sphericity assumption)
checks: extreme outliers per cell (3 IQR); Shapiro-Wilk on residuals; Mauchly sphericity
reference: Singmann et al. afex (CRAN); Greenhouse & Geisser 1959 Psychometrika 24:95; Bakeman 2005 Behav Res Methods 37:379; Lenth emmeans (CRAN)
alternative: Friedman test (one within factor, no between factors) or the mixed model (lmer), which keeps subjects with missing cells

model: mixed (split-plot) ANOVA: between-subject factors, every subject measured at every level of the within-subject factors
correction: Greenhouse-Geisser for within-subject terms; Mauchly's test reported
effect_size: generalized eta squared (ges), partial eta squared (pes)
posthoc: emmeans pairwise or vs-control contrasts, simple effects for interactions
checks: extreme outliers per cell (3 IQR); Shapiro-Wilk on residuals; Levene per within-subject cell; Mauchly sphericity
reference: Singmann et al. afex (CRAN); Greenhouse & Geisser 1959; Bakeman 2005; Lenth emmeans (CRAN)
alternative: the mixed model (lmer), which keeps subjects with missing cells

model: factorial ANOVA, one observation per experimental unit, all factors crossed
test_statistic: F per term (type III, sum-to-zero contrasts)
effect_size: generalized eta squared (ges), partial eta squared (pes)
posthoc: emmeans pairwise or vs-control contrasts, simple effects for interactions
checks: extreme outliers per cell (3 IQR); Shapiro-Wilk on residuals; Levene across cells
reference: Singmann et al. afex (CRAN); Fox & Weisberg car::Anova; Olejnik & Algina 2003 Psychol Methods 8:434; Lenth emmeans (CRAN)
alternative: Kruskal-Wallis (one factor) or a GLM for non-normal outcomes
